PepperGPT turns Pepper into a smart, friendly conversational robot powered by AI. Here is everything you can do:

1. Tap the big Start Listening button at the bottom.
2. Speak naturally — Pepper will listen until you pause.
3. Pepper transcribes your speech, thinks of a response, and speaks back!
4. Tap Stop Listening to stop, or Pepper will keep listening for more.

Ask Pepper about the weather or time:

• What is the weather in Paris?
• How hot is it in Tokyo?
• What time is it in New York?
• What is the weather? (uses your default city)

You can set your default city in Settings.

Paint me a beautiful landscape

The image will appear right in the conversation!

When Pepper tells a story or gives a recipe:

• Words highlight automatically as Pepper speaks them.
• The text will scroll on its own to keep up with the story.
• After it ends, the conversation resumes automatically.
• You can click on previous activity bubbles to review them!

Pepper can play music for you!

• 'Play music' or 'Play radio' (plays Synthwave)
• 'Play pop' (plays Top 40 hits)
• 'Play synthwave' (plays Nightride FM)
• 'Stop music' to end playback.

A music note 🎵 appears at the top when playing.

• Touch Pepper's head to stop speaking immediately.
• Touch either hand to interrupt speech.
• These are useful if Pepper gives a long answer!

At the top of the screen you will see three indicators:

• Wi-Fi — Green means connected to the internet.
• AI — Green means your OpenAI key is configured.
• Clock — Green means time services are available.

If any icon is grey or red, check your network or settings.

Open Settings from the menu (⋮) to:

• Set your own OpenAI API key
• Set your own OpenWeather API key
• Change the default city for weather and time
• Customize Pepper's personality prompt

There are no built-in API keys. Enter your own keys to enable AI and weather.

• Speak clearly and at a normal pace.
• Wait for a brief pause after speaking — Pepper detects silence to know you are done.
• Pepper remembers your conversation, so you can have follow-up questions!
• Chat history is saved and restored when you reopen the app.
